summary: Deliver the resumable adoption transaction controller, regression fixtures and bounded integration documentation

delivery.outcome: Independently publish a tested single-host adoption transaction controller for trusted existing automation adapters, with explicit live-integration limits
nonGoals: Live consumer upgrades or protected deployment
New publisher, migration engine or authority source
Distributed locking, production scheduler or live adapters
Changes to wellmanifest standards or additional ownership rules

architecture.decision: Persist bounded local phase state before effects; require independent adapter readback and fresh authority before progression, with stable idempotency keys and no cached permission
interfaceChanges: Python adoption transaction and trusted adapter API
dataChanges: Private local goal.adoption-transaction/v1 progress journal; not a trusted receipt
architecture.rollback: Do not activate the pilot module; preserve any private journal and use the previously accepted Goal runtime. No consumer migration is performed by this slice.

validation.evidence: Focused durable phase and restart fixture results, not a live adoption receipt
Negative subject, CAS, authority, journal and uncertain-outcome fixtures
Managed gate and whitespace checks for the exact integration scope
Existing pinned planner and protected delivery regression results
